sn46.15:1.1: Ekaṃ samayam Bhagavā Rājagahe viharati Veḷuvane Kalandakanivāpe || || 2.
sn46.15:1.2: Tena kho pana samayena āyasmā Mahā-Moggalāno Gijjhakūṭe pabbate viharati ābhādhiko dukkhito bāḷhagilāno || || 3-5.
sn46.15:1.3: Atha kho Bhagavā sāyanhasamayam paṭisallānā vuṭṭhito-
sn46.15:4.4: -Tathā pahīno cāyasmato MahāMoggalānassa so ābādho ahosīti || || 1.
